verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an app marketplace or installing prebuilt Slack, support desk, marketing, or data warehouse integrations. The available items cover developer APIs, the CLI, test accounts for building apps, MCP servers and connected email. None of these is a marketplace install flow for an ops user. An integrations marketplace is a fair question for a CRM platform, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace
